context_requirements: Expression of the drug's primary targets (voltage-gated sodium channels, two-pore potassium channels, calcium-activated potassium channels, or glutamate transporters) is required for a direct effect.
Neuronal or excitable-cell lineage increases the likelihood of a specific transcriptional response.
Functional glutamate signaling or glutamate transport must be present for pathway-specific changes.
The cell line must not be entirely dependent on non-glutamatergic survival pathways.
falsifiers: No change in any of the primary target genes or glutamate-pathway genes at 6 h or 24 h.
A strong, uniform transcriptional response across all nine cell lines that is indistinguishable from generic stress or proliferation arrest.
No dose-dependent or time-dependent changes in immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h.
Absence of any late (24 h) secondary transcriptional consequences in responsive lines.
